sources.title: Owner-supplied additional roadside and campus references
sources.note: Inspected 2026-10-02. Marked foliage groups, edge planting and open courtyard/lawn connections support draft additions. Standing mapped roofs and full road/path widths govern clearance; image orientation and source-footprint alignment are uncertain. Counts, dimensions, positions and heights are illustrative and undated; no species, survey or construction date inferred. Reference bitmaps remain ignored evidence. The college point anchors a draft visual grounds envelope around the preserved mapped academic roof and western open lawn; it is not a mapped property boundary.
